STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give different answers about whether alignment files are saved in the output directory by default.
- The Sarek output documentation states that alignment files (BAM or CRAM) are not published by default, and CRAM files are saved only with --save_mapped [sarek_output#h013] [sarek_output#h020].
- A pipeline admin note dated 2026-10 states that alignment files (CRAM) are saved to the output folder by default and that no extra flag is needed [fx_sr11_save].
